messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Reduced motion now disables the card border transition in [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:50) and shows the win banner without its pulse in [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:39). Normal motion remains unchanged.

The existing motion test covers both cases; I didn’t run tests.
